newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's new government sworn in.
newsitem.headline: Malta's new government sworn in.

text.p: Malta's new cabinet was sworn in on Tuesday night, with George Vella appointed foreign minister and Lino Spiteri as Economy and Finance Minister.
Labour Prime Minister Alfred Sant, brought to power in last Saturday's general election and sworn in on Monday, watched as President Ugo Mifsud Bonnici swore in the cabinet.

Only three, including Spiteri, have full ministerial experience. The other two are Karmenu Vella, now Tourism Minister, and Joe Debono Grech, Transport and Ports Minister. All three served in the last Labour government in 1981.
Leo Brincat, appointed Trade Minister, was a former junior minister for housing.
Deputy Prime Minister, Foreign Minister and leader of the House of Representative -- George Vella
